name: stdb-es
description: Add event sourcing to your TypeScript SpacetimeDB app with append-only streams, safe retries, replayable state, and live read models.
author: gervel@jscraftsman.com

scripts.example:react-counter:build: npm run build && spacetime build -p examples/react-counter/spacetimedb
scripts.example:react-counter:test: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/react-counter/spacetimedb run test && npm --prefix examples/react-counter/web run test
scripts.example:react-counter:publish-clean: npm run example:react-counter:build && npm run example:react-counter:generate && npm run example:react-counter:typecheck && spacetime publish stdb-es-counter-with-frontend -s local -p examples/react-counter/spacetimedb --delete-data=always -y
scripts.example:react-counter:publish: npm run example:react-counter:build && npm run example:react-counter:generate && npm run example:react-counter:typecheck && spacetime publish stdb-es-counter-with-frontend -s local -p examples/react-counter/spacetimedb
scripts.example:react-counter:start: npm run example:react-counter:publish && npm --prefix examples/react-counter/web run dev
scripts.example:phaser-counter:build: npm run build && spacetime build -p examples/phaser-counter/spacetimedb
scripts.example:phaser-counter:test: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/phaser-counter/spacetimedb run test && npm --prefix examples/phaser-counter/web run test
scripts.example:phaser-counter:publish-clean: npm run example:phaser-counter:build && npm run example:phaser-counter:generate && npm run example:phaser-counter:typecheck && spacetime publish stdb-es-counter-with-phaser -s local -p examples/phaser-counter/spacetimedb --delete-data=always -y
scripts.example:phaser-counter:publish: npm run example:phaser-counter:build && npm run example:phaser-counter:generate && npm run example:phaser-counter:typecheck && spacetime publish stdb-es-counter-with-phaser -s local -p examples/phaser-counter/spacetimedb
scripts.example:phaser-counter:start: npm run example:phaser-counter:publish && npm --prefix examples/phaser-counter/web run dev
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:pack
